title: Help a reviewer find defensible evidence with minimal maintenance burden
observed_evidence: Eleven self-directed case studies are linked with interactive tools and validated calculations. Local optional events are in-memory only; there is no production visitor-retention dataset.
executive_recommendation: Prioritize role-specific navigation and short decision summaries. Judge the site by evidence discoverability and correctness, not invented interview conversions or visitor counts.
priorities: Lead each role path with three relevant projects and their actual evidence limits.
Keep contact URLs clean and keyboard navigation usable.
Use opt-in local QA to validate event mechanics; do not introduce visitor tracking just to fill an analytics chart.
reversal: If added navigation raises maintenance cost without reducing task difficulty, keep the simpler index. Any incorrect claim or privacy violation blocks release.
uncertainty: Synthetic repeat visits cannot measure recruiter interest. The site creates presentation value; avoided reviewer minutes are not cash revenue.

economics.evidence_status: ILLUSTRATIVE ASSUMPTIONS, NOT MEASURED COSTS OR RISK

options.name: Guided role navigation with concise evidence

product.randomization_unit: synthetic reviewer only; no persistent production visitor identifier
product.incident_definition: broken or materially misleading evidence link
product.retention_interpretation: repeat evidence review, diagnostic only; one successful visit may be sufficient
